headline: Clinton order makes another change to the rules for a federal commission studying how the government budgets for long-term investments.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13037, which created the Commission to Study Capital Budgeting. That commission was set up to look at how the federal government plans and pays for long-term assets like buildings and equipment. The title alone does not say what specific change was made.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the Commission to Study Capital Budgeting
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules the commission works under, though the exact change is not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 11, 1998; the effective date is not given in the material provided.
